0.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONTICKET_00438_SEASONREWARD2_000_000
0.description: Ah, now there's a bloodthirsty wolf, <hex:020810E905FF06717565656EFF056B696E6703> of the pack! If you've got your Wolf Collars with you, I'll take them off your strapping neck for a reward.

1.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONTICKET_00438_MENU_000_000
1.description: What do you wish to do?

6.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONTICKET_00438_SEASONREWARD2_001_000
6.description: Left your collars at home, did you? I reckon a rabid beast such as you would have at least a score tucked away.

7.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONTICKET_00438_SEASONREWARD2_001_001
7.description: Hm, seems you already have all the Wolf Marks you're permitted. Such are the rules, I'm afraid.

9.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONTICKET_00438_ASK_000_001
9.description: Warning: You will not be able to receive all the Wolf Marks. Do you still wish to proceed?

10.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONTICKET_00438_SEASONREWARD2_002_000
10.description: Here're your Wolf Marks. You've earned them.

12.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONTICKET_00438_SEASONREWARD2_003_000
12.description: Wolf Collars are proof of your prowess. They're awarded at the end of a feasting season based on your rating.

13.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONTICKET_00438_SEASONREWARD2_003_001
13.description: The amount of collars you get depends on your tier at season's end. The higher the tier, the more you earn. So get your claws and fangs out and rip and tear your way to glory!

14.name: TEXT_REGSEAPVPSEASONTICKET_00438_SEASONREWARD2_003_002
14.description: Mind you, Wolf Collars aren't just for show. You can exchange them here for Wolf Marks and weapons. Don't have enough collars for something you want? Get hungry and get more in the coming season.
